description: This file contains the implementation of the ActivationCountPlacementDirector class, which is a placement strategy within Orleans runtime for deciding which silo to place a new activation on, based on activation counts and silo load statistics.

classes.name: ActivationCountPlacementDirector
classes.description: A placement director that selects silos for placing activations based on activation counts and load balancing, implementing ISiloStatisticsChangeListener and IPlacementDirector.

methods.name: ActivationCountPlacementDirector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the placement director with silo details, deployment publisher, and options.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Asynchronously determines the silo to place a new activation, possibly using placement hints or by selecting based on load.

methods.name: OnAddActivationInternal
methods.description: Internal method to decide the target silo for activation, considering placement hints and local cache.

methods.name: SiloStatisticsChangeNotification
methods.description: Updates internal cache when silo statistics change.

methods.name: RemoveSilo
methods.description: Removes a silo from the cache when it is removed from the cluster.
